ev_energy.basis: modeled distance energy plus travel-time auxiliary energy, rounded up to Wh

graph.routing: OSMnx shortest path by profile travel time on directed OSM ways
graph.scope: largest strongly connected public motor-road component inside the source bounds

provenance.measurement_basis: Current road geometry with modeled light and heavy travel times and electric energy.
provenance.site_basis: Central uses the street access nearest the mapped USC parcel locker. Other sites are scenario curb positions.

speed.basis: OSM maxspeed where usable, with OSMnx edge speed assignment and class defaults
